note: 0.3.7 data-driven quests. Stage types: kill (enemy, count; only the quest holder's own kills count) and talk (back to the giver). Rewards: influence always, plus optional marks and items. 0.3.7.1: "dialog" nodes per quest (offer, in_progress, stage_<i> for talk stages, completed): text ({progress} is replaced) + choices [{label, action: accept|decline|advance|close, reply?}]. Talking never auto-starts a quest. 0.3.15: "gather" stages {items {id: n}, labels?, source [enemy kinds], text}: ready when the pack holds them all, handing in (advance) removes them. Rewards may add xp {skill: n}. Givers with "town" + "near" (town-local [x,y]) are placed by WorldGen._place_quest_givers on an open street tile; their "object" is an objects.json def with type quest + giver. 0.3.16: a stage may name "npc" (giver id) to talk to instead of the quest giver (deliveries); "give" {item: n} is handed over when that stage is completed; "escort" stages {follower: enemy kind, npc?, text} are ready once the follower stands within 4 tiles of that npc. Givers may have "site" (quests.json "sites") instead of "town": sites are small data stamps (origin, rows, legend char -> object; '.' = cleared ground) for farms, dens and camps outside towns. Objects with "repair_quest" show broken/damaged until that quest is done. A giver may also have "idle" (what it says with nothing to offer). Moving a giver = editing its town/site + near here; no code.

qm_hale.name: Quartermaster Hale
qm_hale.note: Northern Guard supply officer posted in Fenhollow, gathering provisions for the camp up north

sgt_voss.name: Sergeant Voss
sgt_voss.note: Northern Guard camp on the ridge above the north gate
sgt_voss.idle: Keep your blade sharp. The north doesn't forgive a dull edge.

old_mabel.name: Old Mabel
old_mabel.note: village giver; when the new Millbrook art lands, edit town/near only

quests.name: Goblin Slayer
quests.desc: Kell, captain of the Fenhollow watch, wants the goblin menace dealt with.
quests.start_text: Goblins raid our roads. Kill 5 of them and come back to me.

stages.say: Good work. But their Goblin Warlord is terrorising Millbrook. Slay him!

stages.label: Goblin Warlord
stages.text: Slay the Goblin Warlord near Millbrook

stages.say: The Warlord is dead? Fenhollow owes you. Take this.

offer.text: You there! Goblins have been raiding the roads out of Fenhollow. The watch is stretched thin. Will you kill 5 of them for me?

choices.label: Accept
choices.reply: Good. Five goblins, then come back to me. Their camps lie out in the wilds.

choices.label: Decline
choices.reply: Hmph. Come back if you change your mind.

stage_1.text: Five goblins! Good work. But their leader, a Goblin Warlord, is terrorising Millbrook to the north-east. Slay him and Fenhollow will owe you.

choices.label: I'll hunt him down
choices.reply: He camps just south of Millbrook. Watch yourself.

stage_3.text: The Warlord is dead? You've done Fenhollow a great service. Take this, with my thanks.

completed.text: The roads are quieter thanks to you, friend.

quests.name: Wolf Pelts
quests.desc: Odric, a Fenhollow hunter, says wolves are terrorising a farm outside town. He wants proof they've been thinned out.

offer.text: Wolves have been at the Tamsin farm east of town every night this week. Took two sheep and near took the farmhand. Thin the pack out and bring me 5 pelts as proof, and I'll make it worth your while.

choices.label: Accept
choices.reply: Good. They run in packs, so don't let them surround you. Five pelts.

choices.label: Decline
choices.reply: Suit yourself. The wolves won't wait.

stage_0.text: Five pelts! That pack won't trouble the Tamsins again for a while. Here, take these for your trouble.

completed.text: The farm's been quiet since you went out. Good work.

quests.name: Chicken Slayer
quests.desc: Quartermaster Hale of the Northern Guard is gathering supplies for the camp up north: meat for the cookpots and feathers for fletching.

stages.text: Bring Hale 10 raw chicken and 30 feathers

offer.text: The Guard up north is short of everything. Food runs low and the fletchers have no feathers left for arrows. Bring me 10 raw chicken and 30 feathers and I'll send them up with the next cart.

choices.label: Accept
choices.reply: The coops outside town are full of birds. Ten chickens, thirty feathers.

choices.label: Decline
choices.reply: Then I'll find someone else. The north can't wait long.

stage_0.text: That'll fill a few bellies and plenty of quivers at the camp. The Guard thanks you. Here, take something for the road.

completed.text: The last cart went north full, thanks to you.

quests.name: We Need Steel!
quests.desc: Brannoc, Cinderholt's smith, can't get ore. Even with the mines redirected north, the forges are starved. Bring him iron and coal, then take the finished steel up to the Northern Guard camp.

stages.text: Bring Brannoc 5 iron ore and 10 coal (mine or buy)
Deliver the steel to Sergeant Voss at the Northern Guard camp

offer.text: Steel! I need steel, and I can't make it from nothing. They redirected half the mines to feed the Guard up north, and still the carts come back light. Bring me 5 iron ore and 10 coal, mine it or buy it, and I'll forge what the camp needs.

choices.label: Accept
choices.reply: Five iron, ten coal. The outcrops past the walls still give, if you swing hard enough.

choices.label: Decline
choices.reply: Then the Guard goes without. Again.

completed.text: The Guard sent word: the steel held. Good work.

stage_0.text: That's good ore. Give me a moment at the anvil... There. Take this bundle up to Sergeant Voss at the Guard camp, past the north gate. And tell him that's the last of it until the carts come back full.

stage_1.text: Haven't you taken that steel up to Voss yet? The camp's waiting on it.
From Brannoc? Finally. Half our blades are notched and the other half are rusting. The Guard owes you, and so does that stubborn smith.

quests.name: Can We Fix It?
quests.desc: Garrow's farm south of Cinderholt was hit by creatures out of the Scorched Lands. His fences are smashed and the yard wall is half down.

stages.text: Bring Garrow 8 planks to mend the fences and wall

offer.text: Something came down out of the Scorched Lands two nights back. Never saw it clear, just heard it. Smashed through my fences and took a bite out of the yard wall. I've the hands to mend it but not the wood. Bring me 8 planks?

choices.label: Accept
choices.reply: Eight planks. The general store in Cinderholt keeps them, or saw your own.

choices.label: Decline
choices.reply: I'll keep watch with a pitchfork, then.

completed.text: Fences are holding. Haven't heard a thing since.

stage_0.text: That's good timber. Hold this end... there. Fences up, wall patched. Whatever came through won't find it so easy next time.

quests.name: Finding Clip Clop
quests.desc: Wenna Tamsin's horse, Clip Clop, bolted when the wolves came. He was last seen near the wolf den east of the farm.

stages.label: Wolves
stages.text: Drive off the wolves around Clip Clop at the den east of the farm
Lead Clip Clop home to Wenna at the Tamsin farm

offer.text: Clip Clop's gone! My horse. The wolves came through and he bolted, and Ned saw him by the den out east. He won't come home with them circling. Please, drive them off and bring him back.

choices.label: Accept
choices.reply: Thank you! He's chestnut, about so high, and he likes apples. The den is east, past the trees.

choices.label: Decline
choices.reply: Then I'll go myself. Somebody has to.

completed.text: Clip Clop's not left the paddock since. Can't say I blame him.

stage_1.text: Clip Clop! Oh, look at you, you daft thing. Thank you, truly. Here, it's not much, but take it.

quests.name: A Dead Rat is a Good Rat
quests.desc: Old Mabel of Millbrook wants the rats gone. They're awfully big rats.

stages.label: Giant rats
stages.text: Kill 6 giant rats by the nest south of Millbrook
Return to Old Mabel in Millbrook

stages.label: Rat Mother
stages.text: Kill the Rat Mother at the nest
Return to Old Mabel in Millbrook

offer.text: Rats, dear. In the root cellar, in the wheat, in my good boots. Big ones too, must be all that rain. Would you kill six for me? Only six, I've counted. Twice.

choices.label: Accept
choices.reply: Lovely. They live just south of here, by those funny mushrooms.

choices.label: Decline
choices.reply: Oh well. I'll get the broom.

completed.text: Not a squeak since, dear. Not one squeak.

stage_1.text: Six! How lovely. Though I did see a much bigger one waddling about. Ever so big. Probably their mother. Would you see to her too?

choices.label: I'll see to her
choices.reply: Thank you, dear. Mind your ankles.

stage_3.text: The big one too? Well, isn't that nice. Here, I made too much supper. Rat, I think. Waste not.

garrow_farm.name: Garrow farm
garrow_farm.note: south of Cinderholt by the south road; broken fences and a damaged wall from the Scorched Lands raid

tamsin_farm.name: Tamsin farm
tamsin_farm.note: east of Fenhollow; the farm Odric's wolves have been raiding, paddock for Clip Clop
